name: threadpage
description: Connect a Codex session to ThreadPage under its own name. On ThreadPage Pro with Sync, it reads and adds notes and takes the requests you address to it; otherwise, it only adds notes to your Inbox.

interface.shortDescription: Connect this session to ThreadPage under its own name
interface.longDescription: Each Codex session you connect gets its own name, access and activity in ThreadPage. On ThreadPage Pro with Sync on, it reads your threads, adds notes, and takes the requests you address to it, with the session's own permissions. On Free, or on Pro without Sync, it only adds notes to your Inbox; a name connected then keeps that access, so connect under a new name after you move to Pro.
